author: Play On Tabletop
description:
The new Orks Codex is here!  The first codex for 11th edition, and boy is it exciting.  So many interesting changes!  

Nick and JT go through the new changes, breakdown the new detachments and give you their impressions on all things orky. 

BONUS!  we bring Mitchel on and reveal our recipe for our Ork skin and what we think of the new Oak miniature line,
